role: RECORD OF A REPAIR PASS. This file seals nothing, advances no status and changes no verdict. It records which checkers were given a duplicate-key guard, which could not be given one and what pins them, and the measured result of each attack. CD-RT-5 remains BLOCKED_ON_PHASE_1A.

theConstraintThatShapedThisPass.rule: A checker whose SHA-256 is pinned anywhere in docs/coop cannot be edited: freeze 7.2 binds a verdict to bytes, so editing reviewed bytes invalidates the review and breaks every pin.
theConstraintThatShapedThisPass.method: sha256 of all 93 artifacts/check-*.py computed, then every file under docs/coop scanned for each digest (64-, 32-, 16-, 12- and 8-character prefixes, upper and lower case), and each target additionally scanned for its own name occurring within 260 characters of a sha/digest token, to catch a STALE pin that a current-digest scan would miss.
theConstraintThatShapedThisPass.result: 89 of 93 checkers carry a digest that appears elsewhere in the tree. Only 4 are unpinned: check-adjudication.py, check-method-dispositions.py, check-package-coherence.py and check-retention-v3.py.
theConstraintThatShapedThisPass.measurementRecordsAreNotPins: artifacts/corpus-duplicate-key-sweep.v1.json and artifacts/corpus-float-admission-sweep.v1.json both declare themselves measurement-only. Digests appearing ONLY in those files were not treated as pins. No checker's status changed because of that distinction — every blocked checker is pinned by at least one non-measurement file.

whatThisPassClosed.note: Each row was attacked with the sweep's order-preserving shape C — the duplicate inserted immediately before the real member so the mutant's last-wins parse is identical in value AND in dict key order — because the sweep found check-d9-v1.7.py reading as defended until key order was controlled for. Every rejection below was confirmed by READING the finding text, not by observing a non-zero exit.
